The 2026-08-14 record for this key was withdrawn for geometry defects; that quarantined record was NOT opened and no value was carried from it -- every figure here was read fresh off the 200 dpi full-page renders and every band was re-measured and crop-proved. FORM ORDER: page 2 is Form B (expenditures) and page 3 is Form A (contributions) -- page position is not the form order on this filing. TYPED (not handwritten) form, signed 9/24/2014, clerk RECEIVED stamp OCT 27 2014. TWIN: this is one of two Wayback recoveries of what may be the same Ulibarri 2014 report (the module also holds wb20160824031236_JUlibarri_1.5.15.pdf, and the cover cache notes that this filer's 12/29/2014 report carries IDENTICAL figures). This filing was transcribed strictly on its own terms; a rollup must decide separately whether to count the report once. The candidate is entirely SELF-FUNDED: all six Form A entries are the filer's own loans from his personal account, and each is matched one-for-one by a same-date Form B expenditure. PRIVACY: Form A prints a full street address in its Address column for every row; only the city/state component (South Ogden, UT) is carried, per PRIVACY.md. Form B's 'City' column prints the literal word 'online' for the two internet vendors -- that is the filer's own verbatim entry, kept as written and not a real city. Cover line 2 (<=$50 aggregate), line 4 (ending balance) and the whole 'Totals From Last Report' column are bare dashes -- NIL MARKS, left BLANK per the zero-glyph ruling, never 0.
